ramp_lag.method: step command, per-control-step sampling, time to 95% of the commanded delta
ramp_lag.note: The measured step-response t95 is 0.10-0.32 s, much shorter than the fixed 1.5 s _ramp used by track_gain.  Use the recommended ramp_s(delta) instead of a constant ramp.

reach_envelope.note: The DLS preview residual (0.017-0.208 m) overstates the mink-QP executed residual (0.008-0.015 m).  Use the preview only as a reachability screen; the QP is the adopted solver.

standoff_envelope.definition: standoff = distance from the base origin to the task object body-tree AABB nearest point; the root distance is reported too

task_05_drill_lift.note: 05 root-distance 0.233 m matches the prior ~0.25 m; the AABB standoff at that pose is 0.139 m.  Pad error 0.0059, joint margin 0.1719, tilt 3.66 deg.

01_box_lift_floor.measured: set_height(0.46) + move_base approach tilted 19.8-29.4 deg; base ran backward; pad error 0.98-1.54

02_push_button.measured: best pad error 0.156 at AABB 0.192 with the panel AABB-centre target; the predicate target is the button (control_panel_button_z), not the panel centre

03_box_lift.measured: best pad error 0.466 at AABB 0.362; the generic target height is above the box

04_push_shelf_forward.measured: shelf approach tilted 20.7-33.0 deg and pushed the 16 kg shelf; the push standoff is a contact distance, not a grasp standoff

06_drill_pnp.measured: best pad error 0.091 at AABB 0.157; the drill target height needs the task-specific grasp point

07_box_table_to_shelf.measured: best pad error 0.440 at AABB 0.306; the box target needs the task-specific grasp point

08_pick_drill_from_holder.measured: best pad error 0.072 at AABB 0.195; the holder blocks the generic drill target

09_obstacle_aware_pick_drill.measured: obstacle approach tilted 90.9-125.1 deg and the base ran away; no standoff number

standoff_envelope.gap: G0: the per-task standoff envelope requires the W1 base_navigate_to_standoff servo and task-specific targets. The hand-rolled move_base approach is not a calibrated standoff servo (tilt 20-125 deg on 01/04/09; it cannot hold the 15 mm pad gate on the others).

adopted.reason: 12-D is the smallest candidate that meets the 15 mm pad and 50 mrad margin gates (executed worst side 0.0146 m, margin 0.1559).  14-D is dominated: same read-only residual (0.00013 m) for 0.2447 s vs 0.0151 s and a (0,0) base search.  17-D under ik is slightly better executed (0.0109 m) but requires the authorized handover and is not the smallest; it is a measured alternative.

grasp_proxy.proxy_definition: lift-phase bilateral hand-object contact (left>0 and right>0) and object rise > 0.02 m
grasp_proxy.benchmark_outcome: full 05_drill_lift task success; the exact IsGrasped sub-condition is not exposed (success_detail only has 'task')
grasp_proxy.failure_boundary: The 3 false positives are the low-lift condition (object rise 0.045-0.081 m < the task's 0.1 m threshold): the proxy is a grasp indicator, not the task predicate.  Close-phase bilateral contact is not sufficient (0/0 on successful good seeds 0 and 3); the lift phase is the reliable read.  One-sided/swept-object episodes (good seed 1 rise 0.185 m; miss seed 2 rise 0.155 m) are correctly not called grasps.  The lift L2 must add the rise/support terms.

adopted.grasp_proxy_boundary: The 3 false positives are the low-lift condition (object rise 0.045-0.081 m < the task's 0.1 m threshold): the proxy is a grasp indicator, not the task predicate.  Close-phase bilateral contact is not sufficient (0/0 on successful good seeds 0 and 3); the lift phase is the reliable read.  One-sided/swept-object episodes (good seed 1 rise 0.185 m; miss seed 2 rise 0.155 m) are correctly not called grasps.  The lift L2 must add the rise/support terms.

gaps.title: per-task standoff envelope blocked
gaps.evidence: hand-rolled move_base approach tilts 20-125 deg on 01/04/09 and cannot hold the 15 mm gate on the others; only 05 is measured
gaps.design_change: run W1 base_navigate_to_standoff before the per-task envelope, or defer the envelope to W1

gaps.title: exact IsGrasped not exposed
gaps.evidence: success_detail only has 'task'; proxy vs full task success = 4 TP / 3 FP / 0 FN / 5 TN, FP = low lift
gaps.design_change: grasp_state_tracking is a grasp indicator; lift_object/task programs add the rise/support terms; never read or imitate the predicate

gaps.title: task-specific targets
gaps.evidence: 02 button vs panel centre; 03/07 box centre; 08 holder drill; 04 shelf side; generic target invalid
gaps.design_change: the target belongs to the task strategy / press-push-place skill, not the generic standoff calibration

gaps.title: 14-D dominated / executed path blocked
gaps.evidence: 14-D same read-only residual 0.00013 m, 0.2447 s vs 0.0151 s, base search (0,0); executed 14-D needs the base-placement servo
gaps.design_change: adopt 12-D; retire the 14-D candidate with this measurement

gaps.title: 17-D alternative
gaps.evidence: 17-D under ik executed worst 0.0109 m vs 12-D 0.0146 m; both meet 15 mm; 17-D requires handover
gaps.design_change: keep 12-D as the adopted smallest; record 17-D as a measured alternative, not the default

gaps.title: DLS preview overstates the QP residual
gaps.evidence: ik_preview DLS 0.017-0.208 m vs QP executed 0.008-0.015 m
gaps.design_change: use ik_preview only as a reachability screen; execute with the mink QP

gaps.title: ramp curve shorter than the fixed ramp
gaps.evidence: step t95 0.10-0.32 s vs the 1.5 s _ramp used by track_gain
gaps.design_change: use ramp_s(delta) = 0.15/0.15/0.15/0.35 s instead of a constant ramp

gaps.title: 01 floor crouch unstable
gaps.evidence: set_height(0.46) + approach tilt 19.8-29.4 deg; pad error 0.98-1.54
gaps.design_change: 01 requires base_height_setpoint + a stable crouch/approach servo; defer the floor standoff to W1

gaps.title: 04 shelf push is a contact problem
gaps.evidence: 16 kg shelf pushed; approach tilt 20.7-33.0 deg
gaps.design_change: the push standoff is a contact distance measured by push_object_to_target, not a grasp standoff

gaps.title: 09 obstacle approach unstable
gaps.evidence: approach tilt 90.9-125.1 deg; base ran away
gaps.design_change: 09 requires collision_free_reach_trajectory / an obstacle-aware standoff servo

gaps.title: lift-phase joint margin at 0.15 m lift
gaps.evidence: good seed 0 reach_lift joint margin 0.0406 rad (below 0.05) at a 0.15 m lift
gaps.design_change: cap the transport lift or add a posture adjustment; the task's 0.1 m lift is safer
